topic: Calibrating virtual sensors for RZK project
summary_markdown:
The discussion concerns the process of setting up virtual sensors and mirroring data for the RZK project. It was noted that after creating the virtual sensors and performing mirroring, historical calibration must be performed.

[p1] clarified that the model needs to be applied to the virtual sensors so they display traffic and unique user counts (uniques) consistent with reality. This is necessary to ensure synchronization of data for someone working on the underlying model.
decisions: Historical calibration must be applied to virtual sensors after mirroring.
action_items: Determine who will restart or apply the historical calibration script/model.
